description: Update a universe. Partial update. Only `holdout_range` is mutable — `name` and `unit_type` are immutable after create.

description.description: Human-readable blurb shown in the universe picker/hovercard.

folder.description: Optional folder name grouping items in the dashboard. Alphanumeric, `_` or `-` (no `/`). Part of the SDK lookup key (`<folder>/<name>`).

holdout_range.description: Inclusive `[lo, hi]` bucket range (0–9999) reserved as the **holdout** — callers hashed into this slice are excluded from every experiment in the universe. `null` disables the holdout. Pro plan or higher required.

id.description: A resource path identifier — an opaque `xxx_<ULID>` id (~30 chars) or the resource's `name`/`key`. 1–128 characters; the upper bound matches the longest name/key any resource accepts, so an over-long value can never name a real row.

anyOf.description: The universe's ordered config schema — the single source of truth for its params.

default.description: Universe-wide default. Returned when the assigned variant doesn't override this param (resolution: variant override → universe default).

name.description: Param key, referenced by `groups[].params` on every experiment in the universe.

type.description: Scalar type of the param's value.

param_schema.description: Replace the universe config schema. Additive changes + default edits are always allowed; removing a param a running experiment overrides is rejected (deprecate-only).

recommended_headroom.description: Basis points of reserved headroom seeded into new experiments in this universe.

name: release_experiments_universes_update
